sentence: It's normal to feel a bit negative sometimes when life is hard.
synonym: It's okay to feel a little sad sometimes
synonymNote: 两者都表示偶尔有负面情绪是可以接受的

distractors.word: It's strange to feel upset sometimes
It's wrong to feel a bit negative sometimes
distractors.note: wrong表示不对，与normal意思完全相反

distractors.word: It's rare to feel a bit negative sometimes
distractors.note: rare表示罕见，不符合normal的常见含义
